biological.citation: Calcium/calmodulin-dependent protein kinase IV promotes imiquimod-induced psoriatic inflammation via macrophages and keratinocytes in mice (PMID: 35869084)
biological.summary: CaMK4 expression is increased in psoriatic lesional skin. CaMK4 inhibits IL-10 production by macrophages and promotes pro-inflammatory gene expression (S100A8, CAMP) in keratinocytes while inhibiting apoptosis. Camk4-/- mice show reduced psoriasis severity with fewer macrophages and altered γδ TCR+ T cell populations.
biological.significance: Camk4-/- mice show reduced disease severity compared to WT

biological.citation: CaMK4: Structure, physiological functions, and therapeutic potential (PMID: 38615920)
biological.summary: CaMK4 is a serine/threonine kinase that regulates T-cell differentiation, podocyte function, tumor cell proliferation/apoptosis, β cell mass, and insulin sensitivity. Review highlights CaMK4's role in T-cell imbalance and parenchymal cell mass in multiple diseases.

biological.citation: CaMK4 controls follicular helper T cell expansion and function during normal and autoimmune T-dependent B cell responses (PMID: 38287012)
biological.summary: CaMK4 controls Tfh cell expansion through transcriptional regulation of Bcl6 via CREMα. CaMK4 inhibition in human Tfh cells reduces BCL6 expression and IL-21 secretion, impairing plasmablast formation. In SLE patients, CAMK4 mRNA levels in Tfh cells correlate with BCL6 expression.
biological.sample_size: B6.lpr lupus-prone mice and SLE patients
biological.significance: Camk4-/- mice show reduced anti-dsDNA titers and kidney IgG deposition

biological.citation: Phosphofructokinase P fine-tunes T regulatory cell metabolism, function, and stability in systemic autoimmunity (PMID: 36449620)
biological.summary: CaMK4 phosphorylates PFKP (6-phosphofructokinase, platelet type) to promote aerobic glycolysis in T cells. CaMK4 deletion improves Treg cell function and stability in lupus-prone mice. PFKP enzymatic activity in SLE CD4+ T cells correlates with disease activity.
biological.sample_size: B6.lpr lupus-prone mice and SLE patients
biological.significance: Camk4-/- mice show improved disease and expanded Treg cells

biological.citation: Impaired CAMK4 Activity Limits Atherosclerosis and Reprograms Myelopoiesis (PMID: 40336480)
biological.summary: CaMK4 is upregulated in advanced atherosclerotic plaques and plaque macrophages. Camk4-/- mice develop smaller, more stable lesions with skewed monocyte populations toward less inflammatory Ly6clow subset. CaMK4 regulates myelopoiesis through ATF6-mediated transcriptional regulation and Nr4a1 expression.
biological.significance: Camk4-/- mice show reduced atherosclerotic lesion size and altered myeloid phenotype

biological.citation: Convergence on CaMK4: A Key Modulator of Autism-Associated Signaling Pathways in Neurons (PMID: 39442785)
biological.summary: CaMK4 is an emerging autism risk gene encoding a key component of Ca2+-activated signaling pathway regulating neurodevelopment and synaptic plasticity. Three pathogenic CAMK4 variants found in individuals with hyperkinetic movement disorder and autism spectrum disorder. Twelve autism-associated genes impact CaMK4 signaling pathways.
biological.significance: Monogenic pathogenic variants identified in CAMK4

biological.citation: TIPRL Regulates Stemness and Survival in Lung Cancer Stem Cells through CaMKK2-CaMK4-CREB Feedback Loop Activation (PMID: 39076120)
biological.summary: CaMKK2-mediated activation of CaMK4 leads to phosphorylation of CREB at Ser129 and Ser133, driving expression of stemness genes (Bcl2, HMG20A). TIPRL-CREB-CaMKK2-CaMK4 positive feedback loop maintains lung cancer stem cell stemness and survival.
biological.significance: TIPRL depletion sensitizes lung CSCs to afatinib and reduces distal metastasis in vivo

biological.citation: ASHG 2023 - Genetic study in African ancestry populations identifies 16 novel loci associated with lung cancer risk
biological.summary: Novel genome-wide significant locus at 5q22.1 with CAMK4 as closest gene associated with lung cancer risk in African ancestry individuals (p < 5 × 10-8). Identified in largest lung cancer genetics study in African ancestry persons (2,540 cases, 4,458 controls).

biological.citation: ASHG 2016 - Rare variants in 5α-reductase-2 and GWAS susceptibility loci are associated with elevated androgen levels in polycystic ovary syndrome
biological.summary: Rare variants in CAMK4 significantly associated with elevated testosterone levels in PCOS (P = 5.98 × 10-8, Padj = 0.0074). CAMK4 variants identified through whole genome sequencing in two-generation PCOS families.

biological.citation: ASHG 2010 - Generalization of GWAS-based genetic effects for blood pressure: The Strong Heart Family Study
biological.summary: SNP rs10491334 in CAMK4 associated with systolic blood pressure in American Indian population (p = 0.02). Demonstrates generalization of GWAS-identified BP loci across ancestral backgrounds.
